_comment: Fill in and pass to --add-screenshot. evidence_id is computed automatically -- do not set it.
_source_type_comment: one of: profile_screenshot, grid_screenshot, post_screenshot, carousel_screenshot, reel_screenshot, highlight_screenshot, visual_realism_example, tagged_post_screenshot, collaboration_screenshot, childhood_memory_screenshot, friend_social_context_screenshot, family_depiction_screenshot, daily_life_screenshot, behind_the_scenes_screenshot
_visual_annotations_comment: optional -- see visual_realism_template.json fields; only set for source_type=visual_realism_example
_relationship_annotations_comment: optional list of {role, basis, confidence, description} -- role: friend_like_context|family_depiction|collaboration|public_creator_interaction|unknown_person; basis: presented_narrative|visually_depicted|verified|inferred|unknown; confidence: low|medium|high
